s: Hannitzrak linqabayv bammeh meqanneach beshabbat ubo t"v seipim mishshum kebod habberiyyot hittiru letaltel abanim leqanneach bahem bebet hakkisse. Vaapillu im nipneh al haggag veyyesh torach lehaalotan immo laggag — hare zeh muttar. Vekamma abanim muttar lehaknis lebet hakkisse? Mi sheyyesh lo maqom qabua lebet hakkisse, dehaynu shelleolam niknas lemaqom echad lippanot sham — muttar lehaknis sham abanim kimlo hayyad, sheim yishtayyeru lo mehen arbit — yeqanneach bahen shacharit, veen kan tiltul shello letzorek. Veap sheacherim niknasim gam ken lippanot bemaqom zeh, veyesh lachush sheyyeqannechu hem bemah sheyyishtayyer mimmennu — en bekak kelum, shennimtza shettiltul hu letzorek acherim veen zeh tiltul shello letzorek, demah li hu mah li acher. Veap al pi shehaacherim yekolin litroach beatzman lehaknis lahem abanim, mikkol maqom kevan sheepshar shekkol abanim ellu shehu maknis yitztareku lo beatzmo im lo yaqdimuhu acherim leqanneach bemah sheyyishtayyeru mimmennu beqinnuach zeh — hare zeh toreach bishbil atzmo:

Abal mi sheen lo maqom qabua lebet hakkisse, sheppaam holek lemaqom zeh upaam lemaqom acher — maknis immo abanim keshiur rosho shel bukena sheddakin bo besamim velo yoter, lepi sheim yishtayyeru lo mehen veachar kak yelek lippanot lemaqom acher — nimtza shettiltel battechilla shello letzorek. Veim nikkar baeben sheqqinnechu bo kebar paam achat — muttar lehakniso apillu hu gadol harbeh, o apillu hen harbeh mimmelo hayyad — muttar littol kullan, dekevan sheqqinnechu bahen veroshem haqqinnuach nikkar bahen — hare hen mukanin veomedin lekak, veen bahen mishshum muqtzeh. Veken abanim sheyyichadan leqinnuach mibbeod yom, ap al pi sheadayin lo qinnach bahen meolam — muttar lehaknisan lebet hakkisse apillu hen harbeh. Vehu sheyyichadan lekak leolam, abal yichud leshabbat achat eno moil, kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"t vsh"ch:

Mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkisse samuk lebeto sheen shum adam acher nipneh lesham — asur lo lehaknis lesham abanim beshabbat ella im ken hen mukanin veomedim lekak, mippene shehaya lo lehazminam sham meetmol, shehare meetmol haya yodea shebbevadday yippaneh sham beshabbat, kevan sheen shum adam acher niknas lesham lippanot. Mah sheen ken kesheggam acherim apillu bene beto niknasim sham lippanot — lo hitrichuhu lehazmin sham abanim mibbeod yom al hassapeq, ki shemma lemachar yimtza acher nipneh sham veyitztarek lelek lippanot bemaqom acher, vegam shemma yeqannechu hem bemah sheyyazmin hu:

Yesh omerim shello hittiru letaltel abanim leqinnuach ella birshut hayyachid, o pachot mearba ammot bekarmelit. Veyesh omerim shemmuttar letaltelan apillu arba ammot bekarmelit umikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid im tzarik lekak, mippene sheissur hakkarmelit gam ken enah ella middibre soperim kemo issur hattiltul, vehittiruhu gam ken mishshum kebod habberiyyot. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:
Im yaredu geshamim al haabanim venitbeu, im rishshuman nikkar — muttar littelan kede leqanneach, veen bazeh mishshum soter velo mishshum tochen:

Tzeror shealu bo asabim millachut haqqarqa — muttar leqanneach bo, veen chosheshim shemma yittaleshu mimmennu asabim, lepi sheap im yittaleshu en kan issur, sheddabar sheen mitkavven hu. Veap sheggiddul haasabim hu millachut haqqarqa — en bazeh mishshum tolesh veoqer dabar miggiddulo bemah shemmagbihem meal haqqarqa, lepi sheap keshehem baavir hem nehenim ugedelim mereach lachluchiyyut haqqarqa, vahare hem kimchubbarim adayin baqqarqa. Veen behagbaha zo shum issur min hattora, ella shemmiddibre soperim asur lehagbiham mishshum shennireh ketolesh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shl"v, umishshum kebod habberiyyot lo gazeru:
Lo yetaltel regeb adama leqanneach bah, mippene sheenah reuya leqinnuach, lepi shehi nipreket:

Asur leqanneach bacheres apillu bechol, mishshum sakkana, shello yenatteq shinne hakkarkashta. Vaapillu im hi cheres chalaqa, kegon meogne kelim shehem chalaqim veenam meqorim et habbasar — en leqanneach bah bechol, mippene sheyyesh lachush likshapim. Ukebar nitbaer besiman g' shebbizman hazzeh en chosheshim likshapim. Abal beshabbat im yesh lepanayv cheres chalaqa utzeror — yeqanneach behacheres, ap bizman shehaya bah chashash keshapim, mippene sheyyesh torat keli aleha sheruya lekassot bah pi hakkelim. Velo yeqanneach behatztzeror, shehu muqtzeh, shello hittiru leqanneach bitzror veeben ella kesheen lo dabar acher hammuttar betiltul leqanneach bo:

Hayu lepanayv tzeror vaasabim mechubbarim, sheshshenehem hem muqtzim — yeqanneach baasabim beodan bechibburan velo yezizem beyadayv, veal yeqanneach batztzeror sheyyitztarek letaltelo beyado. Veen issur beqinnuach haasabim mishshum mishtammesh bimchubbar, shello aseru ella beilan abal lo beyaraq, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shl"v. Bammeh debarim amurim? Baasabim lachim, abal bibeshim en meqannechin bahem, mippene shehamqanneach bedabar shehaur sholet bo — shinnayv hattachtonot nosherot. Veap bizman hazzeh sheen nizharin milleqanneach bedabar shehaur sholet bo, kemo shennitbaer besiman g' — en meqannechim baasabim yebeshim, mippene shehem chaddim umechattekim et habbasar, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Im en lepanayv apillu tzeror veeben leqanneach bahen — yesh mattirin leqanneach apillu beilan hamchubbar, shebbimqom kebod habberiyyot lo gazeru al shimmush bimchubbar. Veap im tzarik leqanneach bealin hamchubbarim bo — hare zeh muttar, veen lachush shemma yittaleshu, sheddabar sheeno mitkavven hu:
Lo yemashmesh bo bitzror shel haqqinnuach lehachaliqo shello yesaret babbasar, kederek shehu memashmesh bechol, mishshum issur ketisha, ella yemashmesh beshinnuy kilachar yad:

Haya tzarik linqabayv veeno yakol lippanot, sherpuato lemashmesh bepi hattabbaat bitzror vekayyotze bo — lo yemashmesh beshabbat kederek shehu memashmesh bechol, dehaynu sheochez hatztzeror bekol hayyad umemashmesh, lepi shebbemishmush hazzeh yesh bo mishshum hashsharat nimin. Veap sheeno mitkavven lekak, mikkol maqom "pesiq resheh velo yamut hu", shebbevadday mashshir nimin bemishmush zeh (velo huttar mishmush zeh ella mippene hassakkana, sheammud hachozer mebi et haadam lide hadroqan). Laken hitzriku laasot al yede shinnuy kilachar yad, dehaynu sheochez hatztzeror bishte etzbeotayv umemashmesh benachat:

Lemashmesh bebarza bepi hattabbaat dinah kitzror, shello yochazenna ella bishte etzbeotayv. Veasur latzet bebarza apillu techuba kullah baggup, shekkevan shemmaknisah tadir kede lachazor ulehotziah, enah betela etzel haggup, vahare zeh kemotzi bepiv ubemarpeqo sheasur middibre soperim. Abal dabar habbalua baggup — muttar latzet bo, kegon libloa margalit o zahab velatzet bahen lirshut harabbim:

Asur lippanot bisdeh nir beshabbat, gezera mishshum hashvaat gumot, ki shemma yittol tzeror mimmeqom gabshushit leqanneach bo veachar kak yashlikennu limqom guma, vahare zeh mashveh et hacharisha, vehu toledet choresh. Veim hi sedeh chabero — ap bechol asur likkanes bah, mippene sheddash niro umeqalqelo:

Abanim gedolot shemmetzaddedim otan kemin moshab chalul veyoshebim alehem besadot bemaqom hamyuchad lebet hakkisse — muttar letzaddedan beshabbat, mippene shebbinyan aray hu, sheeno asuy lehitqayyem, ubinyan aray eno asur ella middibre soperim, umishshum kebod habberiyyot lo gazeru. Umikkol maqom, laasot kemin ohel im gag — asur, ap al pi shehu ohel aray:
